description: This is a unit test class for VcapServicesStringSupplier, designed to verify its behavior related to reading VCAP service configurations from a JSON file, environment variable handling, immutability, and error handling.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringSupplierTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing VcapServicesStringSupplier functionalities, ensuring correct environment setup, immutability, and exception handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixture by loading the resource URL of the test JSON configuration file.

methods.name: setVcapConfigFileEnvironmentVariable
methods.description: Sets the environment variable for VCAP location to point to the test JSON file.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that VcapServicesStringSupplier is immutable and that Path objects are also immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWhenVcapLocationSystemEnvWasNotSet
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the VCAP environment variable is not set.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullPath
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to the 'of' method throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Confirms that the supplier returns the expected JSON content containing 'Krimkram'.

methods.name: tryToReadNonExistingFile
methods.description: Tests that attempting to read a non-existent file results in a proper exception being thrown.
